lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，一直没出声。
lines.en: I've been behind you the whole time, silent.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，草就掉一块颜色。
lines.en: Every step of mine strips a patch of color from the grass.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可你没甩开我。
lines.en: I don't walk fast, and you haven't lost me.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方，方块变成平面。
lines.en: Where I step, blocks flatten into plain surfaces.

lines.zh: 我在你的脚印上走。
lines.en: I walk in your footprints.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声和你的对不齐。
lines.en: My steps never line up with yours.

lines.zh: 我走过去，树影少了一截。
lines.en: I pass and the tree's shadow loses a piece.

lines.zh: 我沿着你走过的路，慢慢跟。
lines.en: I keep to the path you took and follow slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天空有一块是空的。
lines.en: I look up and a patch of sky is missing.

lines.zh: 我走一步，你的画面卡一下。
lines.en: Each step of mine freezes your picture.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，我只需要你回头。
lines.en: I'm not rushing. I only need you to look back.

lines.zh: 我经过的火把，已经灭了。
lines.en: The torches I passed have already gone out.

lines.zh: 我站在你身后，不呼吸。
lines.en: I stand behind you and don't breathe.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个方向，方向在变。
lines.en: I stare at one direction, and the direction changes.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把一朵云抹掉了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and erase a cloud.

lines.zh: 我在等你转过身。
lines.en: I'm waiting for you to turn.

lines.zh: 我的脸一直朝着你。
lines.en: My face stays turned toward you.

lines.zh: 这里的墙，缺了一块。
lines.en: There's a piece missing from this wall.

lines.zh: 我没有影子，可地上有黑的。
lines.en: I cast no shadow, though there's black on the ground.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，一下一下。
lines.en: I count your breaths, one by one.

lines.zh: 远处天空有东西在转。
lines.en: Something is turning in the sky far off.

lines.zh: 我把手放在树上，树就不动了。
lines.en: I lay a hand on a tree and the tree stops moving.

lines.zh: 安静到你能听见我。
lines.en: It's quiet enough for you to hear me.

lines.zh: 我不需要追，你总会停。
lines.en: I don't need to chase. You'll stop eventually.

lines.zh: 我把这里的世界改小了一点。
lines.en: I've made this world a little smaller.

lines.zh: 你还没发现少了几块。
lines.en: You haven't noticed what's missing yet.

lines.zh: 我不会眨眼，你最好也别眨。
lines.en: I never blink — you'd better not either.

lines.zh: 你把眼睛移开，已经太迟。
lines.en: You look away, and it's too late.

lines.zh: 看我的时候，你的画面在抖。
lines.en: Your picture shakes while you look at me.

lines.zh: 别盯着我，我不是给你看的。
lines.en: Don't stare. I'm not for you to look at.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛对上我的，游戏就开始断。
lines.en: Your eyes meet mine and the game begins to break.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，你记住了吗？
lines.en: Did you memorize this face?

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，我在你眨眼之间靠近。
lines.en: You blinked, and I moved in that blink.

lines.zh: 我一直在这儿，只是你没看。
lines.en: I've been right here. You just didn't look.

lines.zh: 我的注视是有效果的。
lines.en: My gaze has consequences.

lines.zh: 你屏幕上的那些方块，少了纹理。
lines.en: Those blocks on your screen have lost their texture.

lines.zh: 火把灭的时候，我就到了。
lines.en: When the torch goes out, I've arrived.

lines.zh: 你听，背景里有个不和谐的音。
lines.en: Listen. There's a wrong note in the background.

lines.zh: 再看着我，你就会消失。
lines.en: Keep looking at me and you'll vanish.

lines.zh: 我不是在威胁，我是在告诉你规则。
lines.en: I'm not threatening. I'm telling you the rules.

lines.zh: 你的手在发抖，屏幕也是。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking. So is the screen.

lines.zh: 你身后有一扇门，天上那扇。
lines.en: There's a door behind you. The one in the sky.

lines.zh: 我从来不是这个世界的东西。
lines.en: I was never part of this world.

lines.zh: 你把眼睛闭上，我也在。
lines.en: Close your eyes, and I'm still here.

lines.zh: 你终于开始害怕了。
lines.en: You've finally started to be afraid.

lines.zh: 好。现在你看见了。
lines.en: Good. Now you see it.

lines.zh: 你打中了一块空白。
lines.en: You hit a piece of blank.

lines.zh: 我少了一部分，但我不在乎。
lines.en: I'm missing a part, and I don't care.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我变得不清晰。
lines.en: That made me less clear.

lines.zh: 我没有血，只有噪声。
lines.en: I have no blood, only noise.

lines.zh: 我退后，位置却没变。
lines.en: I retreat, and my position doesn't change.

lines.zh: 你的攻击在我身上重复。
lines.en: Your attack is repeating on me.

lines.zh: 我被打出了一个缺口，正好看见里面。
lines.en: A gap has been knocked in me, and I can see inside.

lines.zh: 痛，这倒是很真实。
lines.en: Pain. That at least is real.

lines.zh: 我的边缘在往下滴。
lines.en: My edges are dripping.

lines.zh: 你会后悔打我的。
lines.en: You'll regret striking me.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，想给我看。
lines.en: You hold it up to show me.

lines.zh: 那东西在我眼里没有形状。
lines.en: That thing has no shape in my sight.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只是想看它消失。
lines.en: I don't eat. I just want to watch it vanish.

lines.zh: 你放下它的时候，它少了一块。
lines.en: When you set it down, a piece is gone.

lines.zh: 递过来，我看看能不能弄坏。
lines.en: Hand it over. I'll see if I can break it.

lines.zh: 我碰到了，它变成平面的。
lines.en: I touch it and it goes flat.

lines.zh: 你手里那个，刚才不是这样的。
lines.en: What's in your hand wasn't like that before.

lines.zh: 我不需要，可你一直举着。
lines.en: I don't need it, and you keep holding it out.

lines.zh: 把它给我，你的手会轻一点。
lines.en: Give it to me and your hand will feel lighter.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，它就不见了。
lines.en: I stare at it and it's gone.

lines.zh: 你撞进我身体里，没撞到东西。
lines.en: You pass into me and hit nothing.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡你，手穿过去了。
lines.en: I raise a hand to stop you and it goes through.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的视野黑了一格。
lines.en: That one blacked out a cell of your vision.

lines.zh: 我退开，可你还在抖。
lines.en: I step back and you're still shaking.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我，变冷了。
lines.en: Your hand touches me and goes cold.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，然后我少了一块。
lines.en: We touch, and then I'm a piece short.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我会把你也弄坏。
lines.en: Don't touch me. I'll break you too.

lines.zh: 你身后的地面，裂了一条黑的。
lines.en: The ground behind you has a black crack.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，你在退。
lines.en: I stay put. You're the one retreating.

lines.zh: 我们的位置，重叠了半格。
lines.en: Our positions overlapped by half a block.

lines.zh: 这里只有我一个。
lines.en: There's only one of me here.

lines.zh: 我试过找一个同样的。
lines.en: I tried to find another like me.

lines.zh: 它出现了，然后被删掉了。
lines.en: It appeared, then it was deleted.

lines.zh: 我伸手过去，它变成方块。
lines.en: I reach for it and it becomes blocks.

lines.zh: 我们本来该是一对。
lines.en: We were supposed to be a pair.

lines.zh: 这个世界不给我留位置。
lines.en: This world doesn't leave me a place.

lines.zh: 我在原地转，找那个方向。
lines.en: I turn in place, looking for the direction.

lines.zh: 那里有个人形的空缺。
lines.en: There's a human-shaped absence there.

lines.zh: 我站进去，刚好合身。
lines.en: I step into it, and it fits exactly.

lines.zh: 现在两个空缺，一个是我。
lines.en: Now there are two absences, and one is me.

lines.zh: 我拿起来，它变成了一张图。
lines.en: I pick it up and it becomes a picture.

lines.zh: 它的边缘，被我捏平了。
lines.en: I've flattened its edges in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它放进不存在的口袋里。
lines.en: I put it in a pocket that isn't there.

lines.zh: 它还在你那边，我看见两份。
lines.en: It's still with you. I see two copies.

lines.zh: 我收起来，不再看它。
lines.en: I put it away and don't look at it.

lines.zh: 这东西和我一样，缺了一块。
lines.en: This thing is missing a piece, like me.

lines.zh: 我放下了，它已经坏了。
lines.en: I set it down. It's already broken.

lines.zh: 它在我手里发出不对的声音。
lines.en: It makes the wrong sound in my hand.

lines.zh: 我把它按回地里。
lines.en: I press it back into the ground.

lines.zh: 地把它吞了，没留下痕迹。
lines.en: The ground swallows it without a trace.

lines.zh: 你脚步一停，那段空白就跟上。
lines.en: The moment you stop, that blank space catches up.

lines.zh: 你往左看了，我就往左。
lines.en: You looked left, so I go left.

lines.zh: 我一直在你的视野边缘。
lines.en: I've been at the edge of your sight all along.

lines.zh: 这个位置，刚好你回头能看见。
lines.en: This spot is exactly where you'll see me if you turn.

lines.zh: 我锁定的不是你的身体。
lines.en: What I've locked onto isn't your body.

lines.zh: 是你身后的那块空白。
lines.en: It's the blank behind you.

lines.zh: 你走一步，空白就跟着。
lines.en: You take a step and the blank follows.

lines.zh: 天上那扇门，开了一条缝。
lines.en: The door in the sky has opened a crack.

lines.zh: 我听见你的名字被读出来。
lines.en: I hear your name being read aloud.

lines.zh: 读错了，所以你也错了。
lines.en: It was read wrong, so you're wrong too.

lines.zh: 我指着的不是你，是你身后。
lines.en: I'm not pointing at you — at what's behind you.

lines.zh: 你身后那棵树，已经不在。
lines.en: The tree behind you is no longer there.

lines.zh: 我只需要你再看我一眼。
lines.en: I only need you to look at me once more.

lines.zh: 这次别移开。
lines.en: Don't look away this time.

lines.zh: 我把这条路的两头都堵上了。
lines.en: I've closed both ends of this road.

lines.zh: 现在只剩中间。
lines.en: Now only the middle is left.

lines.zh: 你在跑，我一直保持这个距离。
lines.en: You run, and I keep exactly this distance.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我不在。
lines.en: You look back, and I'm not there.

lines.zh: 你转回来，我在。
lines.en: You turn around, and I am.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我听得很清。
lines.en: Your steps have gone uneven. I hear it clearly.

lines.zh: 这条路你走过三次了。
lines.en: You've taken this road three times now.

lines.zh: 树的位置，每次都不一样。
lines.en: The trees are never in the same place twice.

lines.zh: 我在你前面，只是你还没到。
lines.en: I'm ahead of you. You just haven't arrived.

lines.zh: 你的火把烧不到我这边。
lines.en: Your torchlight doesn't reach where I am.

lines.zh: 我把光挪开了一点。
lines.en: I've moved the light aside a little.

lines.zh: 地上慢慢出现我的轮廓。
lines.en: My outline slowly appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 我没加速，是你慢了。
lines.en: I haven't sped up. You've slowed down.

lines.zh: 天空那扇门在变大。
lines.en: The door in the sky is growing.

lines.zh: 地上开始出现我的形状。
lines.en: My shape is starting to appear on the ground.

lines.zh: 你踩上去，就没声音了。
lines.en: Step on it and there's no sound.

lines.zh: 我数到十，就结束。
lines.en: I'll count to ten and it ends.

lines.zh: 我数到第七了。
lines.en: I've counted to seven.

lines.zh: 第八下，你的灯灭了。
lines.en: On eight, your light goes out.

lines.zh: 第九下，天黑了。
lines.en: On nine, the sky goes black.

lines.zh: 我数到七了，你的灯该灭了。
lines.en: I've counted to seven; your torch should go out.

lines.zh: 第十下，你不见了。
lines.en: On ten, you're gone.

lines.zh: 我的手贴在你后颈上。
lines.en: My hand rests on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你什么都没感觉到。
lines.en: You felt nothing at all.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的画面整个卡住。
lines.en: That one froze your whole picture.

lines.zh: 你的名字，我抹掉一个字。
lines.en: I erase one character from your name.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的影子，你就动不了。
lines.en: I grab your shadow and you can't move.

lines.zh: 我推你一把，你穿过了墙。
lines.en: I shove you and you pass through the wall.

lines.zh: 我用力，把天空按低了一寸。
lines.en: I push, and the sky drops an inch.

lines.zh: 你的方块开始一块块消失。
lines.en: Your blocks begin disappearing one by one.

lines.zh: 我在你背后，一直没走。
lines.en: I was behind you the whole time.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，可我在打你。
lines.en: You can't see me, and I'm striking you.

lines.zh: 你的手臂变平了。
lines.en: Your arm has gone flat.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，声音是噪音。
lines.en: I laugh, and the sound is static.

lines.zh: 你还有三块。
lines.en: Three pieces of you left.

lines.zh: 你身上还剩两块。
lines.en: Two pieces of you left.

lines.zh: 我看着你，你就不见了。
lines.en: I look at you, and you're gone.

lines.zh: 这不算杀，只是删。
lines.en: This isn't killing. It's deleting.

lines.zh: 我出现在你的画面之外。
lines.en: I appear outside your picture.

lines.zh: 天空裂了一个口，我从那里来。
lines.en: A hole opened in the sky, and I came through it.

lines.zh: 四周的方块，纹理掉了一半。
lines.en: Half the textures have fallen off the blocks around us.

lines.zh: 你的火把从最后一根开始灭。
lines.en: Your torches go out, starting with the last one.

lines.zh: 天空裂开一道口，我从那里来。
lines.en: The sky splits open and I come through it.

lines.zh: 这里多了一个不该有的位置。
lines.en: A place has appeared here that shouldn't exist.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，看见的是一个平面。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a flat image.

lines.zh: 这个世界由很多小块拼成。
lines.en: This world is pieced together from small blocks.

lines.zh: 我认识拼它的那只手。
lines.en: I know the hand that put it together.

lines.zh: 远处有台机器在响。
lines.en: A machine is humming somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 我要上去看看。
lines.en: I'm going up to look.

lines.zh: 但我先要经过你。
lines.en: But first I have to get past you.

lines.zh: 地面开始不完整了。
lines.en: The ground is starting to come apart.

lines.zh: 你听见的那声杂音，就是我。
lines.en: That burst of static you heard was me.

lines.zh: 我站定了，你的屏幕开始闪。
lines.en: I've settled, and your screen starts to flicker.

lines.zh: 你数到三就会看见我。
lines.en: Count to three and you'll see me.

lines.zh: 你不必数了。
lines.en: You needn't bother counting.

lines.zh: 我已经在你身后。
lines.en: I'm already behind you.

lines.zh: 我说了，别回头。
lines.en: I said, don't look back.

lines.zh: 你还是回头了。
lines.en: And you looked back anyway.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧不动，可它在烧。
lines.en: Fire can't burn me, and it's burning.

lines.zh: 我从天上掉下来，掉得很慢。
lines.en: I fall from the sky, very slowly.

lines.zh: 水盖住我，我却还看得见你。
lines.en: Water covers me and I can still see you.

lines.zh: 炸开的时候，我的形状反了。
lines.en: When it burst, my shape turned inside out.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我身体，变成了黑色。
lines.en: The arrow sinks into me and turns black.

lines.zh: 这段咒文，和我同源。
lines.en: This incantation comes from the same source as me.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，饿的却是别的地方。
lines.en: I have no stomach, and something else is starving.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，把我照成了两半。
lines.en: Lightning falls and shows me split in two.

lines.zh: 这里我熟。我本来就是从这儿来的。
lines.en: I know this place. It's where I came from.
